title: Disassembly of Progressive Cavity Pump
overview: Follow these steps to disassemble a progressive cavity pump.

steps.title: Remove the set plug for the drive pin
steps.description: Use the 916-pound wrench with a 1 1/2-inch drive socket to remove the set plug from the housing. Verify that the plug is completely removed.

steps.title: Remove the hold down plug
steps.description: Screw out the hold down plug from the other side of the housing and remove it with an alignment tool. Verify that the plug is completely removed.

steps.title: Remove the drive pin
steps.description: Use the 916-pound wrench with a 1 1/2-inch drive socket to remove the drive pin from the connecting rod. Verify that the pin is completely removed.

steps.title: Remove the cap screws
steps.description: Use the 3-8 drive, 3/4-inch socket to remove the cap screws from the housing. Verify that all screws are completely removed.

steps.title: Remove the cap
steps.description: Take off the cap and mark its position on the side of the housing or cap, so it can be put back in place correctly. Verify that the cap is removed.

steps.title: Remove the stator and rotor
steps.description: Use a large pipe wrench to secure it tightly on the stator, then use a leverage bar pipe with the pipe wrench to unscrew the stator and rotor from the housing. Verify that the stator and rotor are completely removed.

steps.title: Remove the stator and rotor from the housing assembly
steps.description: Use a helper to slide the stator and rotor out of the housing assembly and set it on the ground. Verify that the stator and rotor are removed.

steps.title: Check the connecting rod washer
steps.description: Verify that the seal on the end of the connecting rod is in place and the connecting rod washer is not damaged. Verify that the washer is present.

steps.title: Check for corrosion
steps.description: Verify that there is no corrosion on the end of the pin and the main shaft cavity. Verify that there are no signs of water seepage around the collar or plugs.

steps.title: Clean and prepare for reassembly
steps.description: Clean the housing assembly and connecting rod to ensure a proper seal when reassembling. Verify that all components are clean and free of debris.
